name: Monind Limited
about: Monind Limited engages in the production and sale of ferro alloys and allied products in India. It offers ferro alloys, such as silico manganese, ferro manganese, and ferro chrome, which are used in the production of various grades of steel. The company was formerly known as Monnet Industries Limited and changed its name to Monind Limited in November 2021. Monind Limited was incorporated in 1982 is based in New Delhi, India.
